{"code": "import numpy as np

# Replace sentinel values with NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].replace('999,999.99', np.nan)

# Convert revenue to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
